appliedUpdates.description: Added eval-prompts command (bun run scripts/eval-prompts.ts) to services.yaml commands. This script was created by eval-infrastructure-and-baselines but not registered.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add a note to the backend-worker skill that TDD (red-green-refactor) is optional for: (1) prompt optimization/engineering tasks where the natural flow is modify-then-verify, (2) pure data fixture or configuration code, and (3) validation-only features with no source code changes. The skill currently mandates 'Tests MUST fail initially (red phase)' which doesn't apply cleanly to these categories.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Three out of four features in this milestone (eval-infrastructure-and-baselines, optimize-dispatcher-prompt, final-prompt-validation) independently noted in their skillFeedback that TDD doesn't map to prompt optimization or validation tasks. The optimize-evaluator-prompt worker was the only one that followed strict TDD, and that was because the evaluator changes were testable code changes (adding sections to buildPrompt).

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Document the evaluator's pass/fail threshold philosophy: 'Set passed to true if the output substantially meets the acceptance criteria. Minor omissions that don't affect functionality should not cause a failure.' This policy is now embedded in the evaluator prompt (src/evaluator/subprocess-transport.ts) but not captured as a project convention. Future evaluator modifications should preserve this nuanced threshold.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: optimize-evaluator-prompt feature added pass/fail guidance directly into the evaluator prompt. This represents a design decision about evaluation strictness that workers modifying the evaluator in the future should be aware of.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Establish a convention for validation-only features that produce no source code changes: workers should create an empty commit (git commit --allow-empty) with a descriptive message to provide a commitId for handoff. This avoids confusion about whether the feature was actually completed.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: final-prompt-validation feature created an empty commit (7277273) because it was a pure verification pass with no code changes. The worker's approach was reasonable but undocumented.
